restaurantName: Kuih Keria Antarabangsa Melaka Haji Jalil
address: Jalan Limbongan, Kampung Limbongan, 75200 Melaka
notes: Fluffy sweet potato doughnuts deep-fried and glazed in caramelized pure Gula Melaka (palm sugar). A quintessential Melaka tea-time treat celebrating historic local palm sugar craft.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Approximately 2.8 km northwest of Jonker Street and The Stadthuys Dutch Square.

address: 12, Jalan D'Albuquerque, Kampung Portuguese, 75050 Melaka
notes: A signature Kristang (Portuguese-Eurasian) fiery curry slow-cooked with chicken, mustard seeds, vinegar, and galangal. An authentic culinary living tradition of the historic Portuguese Settlement.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located inside the historic Portuguese Settlement (Kampung Portugis), approximately 2.1 km southeast of Porta de Santiago (A Famosa).

address: Lebuh Keng Kwee, George Town, 10000 Pulau Pinang
notes: UNESCO-famed spicy and tangy rice noodle soup in a rich mackerel fish broth infused with tamarind, lemongrass, bunga kantan (torch ginger), and prawn paste (hae ko).
nearbyAttractionNotes: Situated in central George Town UNESCO World Heritage Zone, 0.7 km from Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion and Khoo Kongsi.

address: Pengkalan Weld (Weld Quay), George Town, 10300 Pulau Pinang
notes: Smoky flat rice noodles wok-tossed over intense fire with prawns, cockles, fresh eggs, chives, and aromatic halal seasoning capturing George Town's iconic hawker heritage.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located along the historic George Town waterfront (Weld Quay), 0.3 km from Khoo Kongsi and Clan Jetties.

address: G08, Pusat Rekreasi Bistari Impian, Jalan Serantau, Taman Dato Onn, 80350 Johor Bahru, Johor
notes: Distinctive Johor laksa pairing Italian spaghetti with a fragrant, thick spiced gravy made from fresh ikan parang (wolf herring), kerisik, and dried prawns, traditionally savored by hand.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Approximately 3.2 km northeast of Sultan Abu Bakar State Mosque and Johor Bahru Heritage Trail.

address: 11, Jalan Padi Malinja 11, Bandar Baru UDA, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor
notes: A royal Johor delicacy simmered for up to 3 days in a brew of mangosteen peels, guava leaves, and herbs, resulting in a dark, aromatic, deeply flavorful hard-boiled egg traditionally served at Malay weddings.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in Bandar Baru UDA, Johor Bahru; ~5.5 km northwest of Sultan Abu Bakar State Mosque and the historic centre.

address: No. 55, Kampung Baru Simpang Pasir, 08700 Jeniang, Kedah
notes: Ancient Malay fermentation craft where freshwater fish is preserved with sea salt, toasted ground rice (beras sangai), and asam keping, pan-fried with onions and green chilies.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in rural Jeniang, Kedah; a living representation of traditional agricultural food preservation.

address: No. 250, Jalan Kuala Kedah, Teluk Kechai, 06600 Alor Setar, Kedah
notes: Traditional Northern Kedah laksa with freshly pressed rice noodles served in a savory mackerel and tamarind broth garnished with cucumber, polygonum (daun kesum), and boiled egg.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Situated along Jalan Kuala Kedah (Route 78) in Teluk Kechai; ~5 km southwest of Masjid Zahir and central Alor Setar.

address: Jalan Bayam, Kampung Dusun Muda, 15200 Kota Bharu, Kelantan
notes: Vibrant blue rice tinted with bunga telang petals, served with fragrant sautéed coconut sambal tumis, fresh raw ulam herbs, solok lada, salted egg, and fermented fish sauce (budu).
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located 1.7 km south of Istana Jahar (Museum of Royal Traditions) and central Kota Bharu Cultural Zone.

address: S/211, Jalan Kampung Cina, Kampung Cina, 15350 Kota Bharu, Kelantan
notes: Legendary East Coast custardy dessert baked over coconut husk embers in bronze molds, yielding a wrinkled golden top with an intensely creamy duck egg, pandan, and palm sugar center.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in the historic Kampung Cina heritage enclave along the Kelantan River in Kota Bharu, ~1.5 km north of Istana Jahar.

address: Kampung Dato Abdul Samad, 71400 Pedas, Rembau, Negeri Sembilan
notes: Traditional Minangkabau curry featuring smoked meats cooked in unadulterated coconut cream, fresh turmeric, and fiery bird's eye chilies without onions, celebrating pure Adat Perpatih cuisine.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located along the Rembau-Pedas heritage corridor, renowned for authentic Minangkabau salai crafts.

address: Kampung Tanjung Bangkung, 71500 Kuala Pilah, Negeri Sembilan
notes: Beef cured and smoked for hours over coconut shells, then simmered in a golden turmeric and chili api broth with sour starfruit or pucuk ubi.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in Kuala Pilah district, approximately 8.5 km from the historic Istana Lama Seri Menanti.

address: Dataran Patin Tg Keramat, Kampung Bangau Tanjung, 28000 Temerloh, Pahang
notes: Pahang's culinary pride: succulent silver river patin fish simmered in fermented durian pulp (tempoyak), turmeric, and bird's eye chilies along the banks of the Pahang River.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located at Dataran Patin on the Pahang River waterfront in Temerloh ('Bandar Ikan Patin').

address: No. 1, Gerai Bumiputera, Pasar Besar Pekan, Jalan Sultan Abdullah, 26600 Pekan, Pahang
notes: Exclusive Pahang royal dessert made from sweet pisang lemak manis bananas, golden egg yolk threads (jala mas), prunes, and toasted cashews served with rich chilled evaporated milk sauce.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in Pekan royal town, just 0.3 km from Sultan Abdullah Mosque Museum.

address: 134, Jalan Taiping, Bukit Chandan, 33000 Kuala Kangsar, Perak
notes: Royal Perak heritage dry beef rendang slowly braised in huge cauldrons for over seven hours with toasted coconut, galangal, lemongrass, palm sugar, and warming spices.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in the royal town of Kuala Kangsar, 1.4 km from the magnificent Ubudiah Mosque and Royal Mausoleum.

restaurantName: Fatt Gor Ipoh Bean Sprouts Chicken Hor Fun & Rice
address: 188 Food Centre, 270, Jalan Sultan Idris Shah, 30300 Ipoh, Perak
notes: Silky-smooth flat rice noodles made with local limestone spring water, bathed in clear chicken and prawn broth with tender poached chicken and crunchy Ipoh bean sprouts.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in central Ipoh, within walking distance of the Ipoh Old Town heritage shophouses.

address: Jalan Kuala Perlis, 02000 Kuala Perlis, Perlis
notes: Authentic Perlis laksa prepared with home-extruded rice noodles in a rich, velvety shredded ikan selayang (sardine) broth infused with daun kesum and served with shredded cucumber.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Situated in the coastal town of Kuala Perlis, near the estuary and ferry terminal.

address: Changlun - Kuala Perlis Hwy, 02000 Kuala Perlis, Perlis
notes: Fresh Straits seafood char-grilled wrapped in banana leaves with aromatic sambal paste, served with tangy air asam and tamarind dip overlooking the Perlis coast.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located along the scenic coastal highway at Kuala Perlis fishing haven.

address: Bangunan Dato Nazir, Jalan Kelab, 43000 Kajang, Selangor
notes: Generous skewers of marinated meat grilled over wood charcoal, accompanied by compressed rice cakes (ketupat), cucumber, and rich sweet-spicy peanut sauce with chili sambal.
nearbyAttractionNotes: The flagship home of Kajang's nationally recognized satay culture at Stadium Kajang MRT station.

address: No. 51, Ground Floor, Jalan Putra Permai 1A, Taman Equine, 43300 Seri Kembangan, Selangor
notes: Javanese-Selangor communal dish served on a banana leaf platter: fragrant white rice surrounded by chicken rendang/opor, sambal goreng tempe, serunding kelapa, and mee goreng.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in Seri Kembangan; authentic representation of Selangor's coastal Javanese culinary tradition.

address: 37, Jalan Masjid Abidin, 20200 Kuala Terengganu, Terengganu
notes: Steamed fragrant rice cooked with santan, fenugreek seeds, and shallots, served with rich gulai ikan tongkol (tuna curry), hard-boiled egg, and pickled cucumber salad.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Situated in downtown Kuala Terengganu near Masjid Abidin, 4 km east of Terengganu State Museum Complex.

address: No. 10, Jalan Losong Feri, Kampung Losong Masjid, 21000 Kuala Terengganu, Terengganu
notes: World-famous Losong fish sausages made with high-ratio fresh mackerel fish and sago flour, boiled or crispy-fried, served with sweet homemade chili dip.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in Kampung Losong (heritage capital of keropok lekor), just 1.1 km from Terengganu State Museum Complex.

address: Lot 17, Ground Floor, Lorong Dewan, Pusat Bandar Kota Kinabalu, 88000 Kota Kinabalu, Sabah
notes: Prized Kadazan-Dusun cultural dish of fresh mackerel fillet cured in wild lime juice with grated wild mango (bambangan) seed, ginger, shallots, and bird's eye chilies.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in the historic Australian Place / Lorong Dewan quarter, only 0.2 km from Atkinson Clock Tower.

address: Kampung Kuala Papar / Pekan Papar, 89600 Papar, Sabah
notes: Traditional Bruneian-Malay flower-ring biscuit from Papar crafted from rice flour and red palm sugar, dipped in batter and fried twice for a delicate, crunchy lattice.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in Papar, Sabah's traditional center for artisan kuih cincin production.

address: Persiaran Ban Hock, 93000 Kuching, Sarawak
notes: Award-winning Dayak culinary specialty: chicken marinated with lemongrass, ginger, torch ginger flower, and tapioca leaves, cooked inside fresh bamboo stalks over open embers.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located in Kuching city center, 0.9 km from the Kuching Waterfront and Fort Margherita.

address: Jalan Main Bazaar, 93000 Kuching, Sarawak
notes: Intricately geometric, multicolored Sarawak layered cake baked with pure butter, spices, and jam, requiring master craftsmanship and geometric precision.
nearbyAttractionNotes: Located directly on the historic Kuching Main Bazaar waterfront, 0.4 km across from Fort Margherita.
